P1-editor-native: likely editor-native node, not an ordinary runtime API.
P2-editor-shape-and-syntax: likely literal constructor/control-flow shape or block syntax; capture sockets and labels.
P2-fuzzy-candidate: similarity lead only, not a confirmed mapping.
P3-officially-clarified-concept: official docs resolve the concept, but exact observed editor selector/wiring still needs review.
caveats: A no-match in a third-party v1.5.0 library mirror does not prove the item is absent from current Craftland Studio.
An approximate candidate is never an exact match or a support claim.
The old PC library catalog is not a complete Mobile visual-block catalog.
No entry in this queue is marked compiled or runtime-tested.
